decision: Selected the Ryhti reference point of permanent building 1042766275, the 22,476 m2 data-centre building (RAK 1 of Utajärvi building permit 26-0014-RL, Ryhti permit 302403882X) on property 889-407-4-131 'Tietomaa' at Prosessitie in the Mustikkakangas industrial area, as the project locator for the Data Tank Nordic campus development. It locates that building's register point; it is not a footprint, the 26.4 ha property, a works extent or an entrance.

selected_properties.main_purpose: code 02 (office, production, utility and other buildings)
selected_properties.address: Prosessitie 4, 91600 Utajärvi (Ryhti open_permit_address, local_data/country-research-nordics-p2/ryhti-utajarvi-addresses.json); the permit decision gives the building-site address as Prosessitie 2

identity_bridge: Utajärvi Lupa- ja valvontalautakunta (permit and supervision board), 14 April 2026, § 16, building permit 26-0014-RL: applicant Data Tank Nordic Oy; building site 889-407-0004-0131, property name Tietomaa, 263,910 m2, detailed plan of 2024; works: substation, battery storage, backup generators, a control building and four data-centre buildings, RAK 1 22,476 m2 / 189,340 m3, RAK 2 to RAK 4 21,300 m2 / 184,250 m3 each and RAK 5 368 m2 / 1,710 m3 (86,744 m2 in all); site address Prosessitie 2; approved.

Ryhti: permit 302403882X on property 88940700040131 (889-407-4-131), decided 14 April 2026 (the board meeting date), carries building records of exactly 22,476 m2 / 189,340 m3, 21,300 m2 / 184,250 m3 (two records) and 368 m2 / 1,710 m3, all new buildings at Prosessitie 4 and still planned (code 1). The third 21,300 m2 data-centre building of the decision has no Ryhti record in the capture.

Utajärvi municipality news of 9 October 2026 (NYAB release) and 15 October 2026: the campus is developed by Data Tank Nordic Oy, the project company of AMP Tank AG, and would comprise four data-centre buildings with a combined 200 MW; NYAB Finland Oy is the first-phase contractor; construction works have begun.
